claimed_coverage: Tests that CLUSTERING_KEY values from Snowflake tables are correctly captured in dataset customProperties by the ingestion pipeline.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix in snowflake_schema_gen.py checks if table.clustering_key exists and adds it to customProperties['CLUSTERING_KEY'] when non-null.
issue_context_used: The issue describes that CLUSTERING_KEY column values must be read from query results and added to customProperties when non-null, with golden file validation.
notes: Created standalone test that mocks Snowflake query results with CLUSTERING_KEY='LINEAR(COL_1)' and verifies the ingestion pipeline captures it in customProperties. Test does not mutate /workspace.
